name: AdministratorAccess attached to IAM user
description: LOCAL STAGED: review required; successful activity only. Not a production verdict.
query: lab.provider: "aws" AND lab.event_source: "iam.amazonaws.com" AND lab.event_name: "AttachUserPolicy" AND lab.policy_arn: "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess" AND NOT lab.error_code: *
author: Owner A
false_positives: Authorized lab administration; triage change authorization before escalation.
note: Owner B reviews every response. No automatic response or external connector.
